BackstoryDef.title: janitor's kid
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] childhood trailing a parent through the corridors of an orbital habitat after hours, carrying the bucket.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] learned which panels hid the best shortcuts, and that nobody notices a clean floor until it isn't.

BackstoryDef.title: custodian
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] kept a glitterworld academy spotless for two decades. Students came and went; the floors stayed immaculate.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] can fix a jammed door, calm a flooded lavatory and find anything anyone ever lost. [PAWN_pronoun] has opinions about mud.

BackstoryDef.title: sanitation worker
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] worked the night shift in the waste tunnels beneath an urbworld megacity, where the rats were the size of dogs and the dogs were worse.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] can stomach any mess, and keeps a heavy tool within reach.

BackstoryDef.title: latrine keeper
BackstoryDef.description:
[PAWN_nameDef]'s tribe gave [PAWN_objective] the job nobody wanted: digging the latrine trenches, hauling the night soil to the fields, and sweeping the longhouse floor before the elders woke.
[PAWN_pronoun] knows which plants grow best on what [PAWN_pronoun] carried, and nobody argues with someone holding the dung shovel.
